race.comment: I'M NELSON (12) is one of, if not the, main winning chance. Turns up bringing a solid Doomben fourth two back and a wide-run fourth at Moree last start. Should be at his top now but will need a clever steer from out there. GOLDEN LOOM (7) is in the mix after back-to-back placings, the latest when beaten a lip at the Sunny Coast where he was held up on the turn and forced wide late. The trip is a query but he only needs to hold his form to be very competitive this time. AND I AM (6) resumes after trialling locally, with last campaign's BM58 win and CL2 fourth good enough to make him dangerous if forward enough first-up. NORTH COURT (2) was much better here second-up when beaten a head as favourite. Has more to offer third-up but is drawn sticky.
